Tender Notice - 21
Tuesday, 30 January 2018
5646 Hits
The Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram invites sealed tenders for the following items. The tenders in sealed envelope superscribed with name of the item and Department
should be submitted in the office of “The Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram, Maharashtra 442102” latest by 15/02/2018 up to 3.00 PM. The Technical Bids will be open on the next day i.e. 16/02/2018 at 3.00 pm in the Committee Room, Dean Office. The tender fees of Rs. 1,000/- (nonrefundable) is to be paid through RTGS/NEFT favoring Kasturba Health Society payable at Wardha. (Details are as mentioned below). Receipt of payment should be attached with tender documents (in Technical Bid). Tender forms also can be obtained by sending email to ‘
centralstore@mgims.ac.in
’ or can be downloaded from the institute website (www.mgims.ac.in).
The Dean reserves the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
1. Name of the Account - The Kasturba Health Society
2. Name of the Bank - Axis Bank Ltd., Wardha
3. Bank Address - Indira Market Road, Wardha – 442001
4. Account Number - 917010025302943
5. IFSC Code - UTIB0000808
6. Branch Code - 808
7. Swift Code - AXISINBB048
8. MICR Code - 442211002
A) CSSD Department:
1) Vertical Pre vaccum Sterilizer - 2, 2) Rectangular high pressure high vacumn steam sterilizer - 1 + 1, 3) Electronic Data Recorder - 1, 4) SS Wash Basin - 1, 5) Biological Indicator Incubator - 1, 6) Endoscope Washer Disinfector - 1, 7) Washer disinfector (200ltrs ) with accessories - 1
Tender Document
B) MCH, Melghat Project:
1) Electric Lawn Mower - 3, 2) Double Drum Vibratory Road Roller - 1
Tender Document
C) Skin & VD Department:
1) Laser for Pigment removal - 1, 2) Laser for Hair removal - 1
Tender Document
D) MS Office:
1) Floor Cleaning Machine (Ride On) - 5 + 1, 2) Street Sweeper Machine 2 + 1, 3) Manual Sweeper Walk Behind Machine - 4, 4) Blockage Removal Rod Machine (Electric Operated) - 1, 5) Blockage Removal Machine (Petrol Operated) - 1, 6) Sink Drainage blockage removal machine (Electric Operated) - 1, 7) Arial Work Platform (Battery / Electric Operated), 8) Complete Safety Kit - 4, 9) High Pressure Jet Machine (Electric Operated) - 4, 10) Biomedical Waste Dust Bins with Wheel base trolley (Set of 4 bins) - 80 Sets, 11) Floor Cleaning Machine Walk Behind Scrubber Drier Electric / Battery operated - 15 + 1
Tender Document
E) Anaesthesiology Department:
1) Liquid Oxygen Plant - 1
Tender Document
F) Community Medicine Department:
1) Garbage Compactor Machine - 1
Tender Document
G) EMD Section:
1) Individual RO Systems for Hospital & College - 22
Tender Document
H) HIS Department (2nd Call):
1) Storage of High Capacity - 1, 2) Number Plate Identification Cameras - 8,
3) Night Vision Cameras - 8, 4) Outdoor Shied - 8
Tender document
Corrigendum
With reference to Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram Tender Notice - 21 (2017-18) published on dated 26th January 2018 in Indian Express & Loksatta news papers. The Item for Anaesthesiology Department read as Medical Oxygen Generator instead of Liquid Oxygen Plant. The Technical Bids will be opened on the next day i.e. 16/02/2018 at 3.00 pm in the Committee Room, Dean Office. The remaining terms of the tender will remain the same.
